output.summary: The decline is mostly explained by the forced move to the smaller, hard-to-reach Brightwater venue, plus a regional headwind. Peers lost a median 29% with no venue change. Our single-ticket sales fell 45% in one year, and the cathedral downtown dates sold far better. Programming is not supported as the main driver. Post-1945 concerts sell the same as others, renewal among engaged subscribers is stable at about 85%, and only 11-12% of lapsed or reduced-attendance patrons cite programming. Marketing is untested because nothing is attributed. Non-renewal would forfeit $400k a year of key-person grant money on weak grounds, and cutting new works would risk the $180k grant. Present a segmented analysis and use the cathedral and shuttle options.
